BladeNet obtains an Average Precision (AP) of 0.995 for blade detection on the Ørsted turbine blade inspection dataset.
BladeNet achieves an AP of 0.223 for blade detection when transferred to the DTU NordTank onshore turbine blade dataset.
The Ørsted turbine blade inspection dataset contains 2637 high-resolution (6720 x 4480) drone images of offshore wind turbine blades.
The DTU NordTank dataset contains 1170 images of onshore wind turbine blades.
BladeNet's U-Net based instance segmentation module produces high-quality, tightly-fitted blade masks that capture important edge details.
Other object detection methods like Mask R-CNN, YOLACT, and Cascade Mask R-CNN exhibit wavy, imprecise blade edge detection.
BladeNet introduces negative class examples of sky and ground during training to help the model focus on the relevant blade regions.
The PANDA semi-supervised anomaly detection method in BladeNet achieves an AUC of 0.639 on the Ørsted blade inspection dataset.
PANDA has a tighter 95% confidence interval (0.631 to 0.648) compared to other semi-supervised anomaly detection methods evaluated.
PANDA in BladeNet has a faster inference time of 50.3 ms per image compared to other semi-supervised anomaly detection approaches.
BladeNet's dual-stage architecture of blade detection/extraction followed by semi-supervised anomaly detection enables it to generalize to detect a wide range of real-world blade surface anomalies.
Accurate blade detection and extraction is crucial for the semi-supervised anomaly detection methods in BladeNet to learn clean representations of normal blade data.
Conventional object detection methods can fail to capture important blade regions like the tip and triangular edges that are prone to anomalies.
Semi-supervised anomaly detection avoids the need for comprehensive annotations of all possible anomalous blade defects, which would be difficult to obtain.
BladeNet demonstrates the ability to transfer its blade detection model trained on the Ørsted offshore dataset to the DTU NordTank onshore dataset with good performance.
